dog.description_text:
Hi, I'm Eliza, a 10-month-old blond beauty with boundless energy and a whole lot of love to give! 🐕 I'm already spayed and ready to go, so you can take me straight home. I'm a spirited girl who needs an active household where I can burn off steam and grow into my best self — think daily walks, playtime, and mental enrichment. Fair warning: I can be protective of my toys and food, so I'd do best in a home where my people understand my needs and help me learn to share. If you've got the energy to match mine and patience to help me thrive, let's meet! 💛
This cutie resides at our Westhampton location. We invite you to visit, no appointment needed!
Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
